title: Aleksander Gierymski, Girl from Bronowice, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description This next coin in the series dedicated to the work of Aleksander Gierymski focuses on quiet presence and restraint. Girl from Bronowice is a composition built on detail and atmosphere. Free from pathos and narrative shortcuts. The issue preserves the realist character of the original, reflecting its calm, light, and simplicity of form. It is a proposition for collectors who seek attentiveness and timeless elegance in art.
